newsitem.title: USA: Cars pile up on Colorado highway in snowy weather.
newsitem.headline: Cars pile up on Colorado highway in snowy weather.

text.p: Heavy snow and icy conditions on an interstate highway south of Denver on Thursday sent as many as 50 cars crashing into each other, authorities said.
Four people were listed in critical condition at area hospitals.

The accident occured about 15 miles south of Denver on Interstate 25 and closed the highway in both directions. Officials sent out a call for all emergency vehicles in the area to be dispatched to the site.
Another multiple-vehicle accident occurred about a mile south of the first pileup after traffic started backing up, a Colorado Department of Transportation spokeswoman said.
